# FDG5034

> AVOID using indexed properties with more than one parameter.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.2.1 Indexed Property Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG5034
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Message: Use methods instead of the indexer of '{0}' with more than one parameter

FDG5034 reports an externally visible indexer with more than one parameter. Indexers that override or implement another member are not reported. The body asks to reconsider whether the indexer really is an accessor to a logical collection, which symbols do not show; a report on such a collection (a matrix, for example) is not a violation. Replacing an indexer with methods changes the public API, so there is no code fix.

## From the book

If the design requires multiple parameters, reconsider whether the property really represents an accessor to a logical collection. If it does not, use methods instead. Consider starting the method name with `Get` or `Set`.
